questions.question: What does the servant in Isaiah 49 become for the nations?
options: A mighty warrior who breaks all of the nations with a great rod of iron
A righteous judge who will one day rule over all of the peoples with justice
A glorious king who will sit upon the high and golden throne of Babylon
A light for the nations, that salvation may reach the end of the earth
questions.answer: A light for the nations, that salvation may reach the end of the earth

questions.question: How does God answer Zion's fear of being forgotten in Isaiah 49?
options: Your enemies are very mighty and strong, but I myself will scatter them all before your eyes
Though you have surely sinned greatly, turn back to me again and I will surely receive you once more
Can a mother forget her child? Even so I will not forget you; I have engraved you on my palms
Wait but a very little while longer, and I will send to you a deliverer to set you wholly free
questions.answer: Can a mother forget her child? Even so I will not forget you; I have engraved you on my palms

questions.question: God says it is too light a thing for the servant only to restore Israel; he will also be salvation to the nations.
I will make you as a light for the nations, that my salvation may reach the end of the _____.
